result.brief: 提出空间对齐的视觉-触觉-语言-动作模型，用触觉接触图与冻结3D几何教师监督视觉token预训练，并构建1000小时全手触觉人类操作数据集。
result.reason: Tactile-supervised visual token pretraining (contact maps, 3D geometry teacher) is a representation-learning contribution, but the paper's core is a robot VTLA policy, placing it in the applications tier.
